verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Lord, make me a house
Make me a house of prayer
Lord, make me a house
Make me a house of prayer
A house of prayer

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
May the fire on my altar never burn out
The fire on my altar never burn out
May the fire on my altar never burn out
Make me a house of prayer

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Day and night, night and day
Day and night, night and day
Day and night, night and day
Make me a house of prayer
